neighbours.label: A word meaning 'in total / altogether' that introduces a grand sum (Altogether, a total of, in all, Russian 'Всего'), not 'together' or other adverbs
fire: The north stand holds 4,000 fans and the south stand 6,000. Altogether, the ground seats 10,000.
Rescue crews pulled a total of 37 survivors from the wreck during the night.
By the end of the war the yard had launched, in all, sixty-two ships.
В библиотеке хранится много старых карт. Всего в коллекции более трёх тысяч листов.
Three sisters and four brothers grew up in the house. Altogether there were seven children.
The charity raised a total of nine thousand pounds at the summer fair.
He wrote four novels and two plays, six books in all, before he turned thirty.
The first truck carried 20 crates and the second 15. Altogether, 35 crates reached the depot.
quiet: The north stand holds 4,000 fans and the south stand 6,000. Yesterday, the ground was empty.
Rescue crews pulled another 37 survivors from the wreck during the night.
By the end of the war the yard had launched, in secret, sixty-two ships.
В библиотеке хранится много старых карт. Вчера в коллекции появились три новых листа.
Three sisters and four brothers grew up in the house. Together they ran the family farm.
The charity raised nearly nine thousand pounds at the summer fair.
He wrote four novels and two plays, mostly in Paris, before he turned thirty.
The first truck carried 20 crates and the second 15. Eventually, both trucks reached the depot.

notes: Card: 'gether' of Altogether, ' total', ' all', Russian 'его' of Всего, Arabic مجموع. Probes: Altogether 0.74, Всего 0.94, a total of 0.40, in all 0.34; together 0.02, Afterwards 0.01, sum 0.08, 'not altogether happy' 0.18.
